steps.text: Click on “Profile”
Click on “Customer Information”
NOTE: User can receive an update information request upon login

View Account Information which includes the following: 
a. Name 
b. Branch 
c. Account opening date 
d. Last update date

Click on FATCA Information to update the following: 
a. I am a US Citizen 
b. I am a green cardholder 
c. I have a POA issued to someone with a US address 
- Power of attorney is a legal document that allows someone else to act on their behalf. 
d. I have a US address or mobile number
NOTE: if any question from FATCA section is answered yes and no W9 previously signed, user is referred to branch after clicking Submit
Click on Personal Information to update the following

substeps.text:
I am or any of my first-degree family members are a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) 
- If yes, then it is mandatory for the user to enter his or family member information including: 
 Relationship with PEPs 
 Name of PEP 
 Role of PEP .
I have a disability\n- User is required to specify disability type
I am not the beneficial account owner \n- User cannot proceed with the update and will be redirected to refer to branch message after clicking Submit
I have a POA? \n- User cannot proceed with the update and will be redirected to refer to branch message after clicking Submit

steps.text:
Click on Residential and Contact Information to update the following: 
a. Country 
b. City 
c. District (Area) 
d. Street Name 
e. Building Number 
f. Building Name (optional) 
g. P.O Box (Optional) 
h. Mobile Number  
- Noneditable, can be updated by clicking on the “update mobile number” from profile 
i. Email 
- Noneditable, can be updated by clicking on the “Update Email” from profile

NOTE: if the user selects another residential country other than Jordan, then they will be required to enter the following fields: \n- Home country fields and it needs to be Jordan \n- The user must fill the following as well: 
 Home City 
 Home District  
 Home building name/floor/unit 
 Home street name 
 Home P.O Box (Optional) 
 Home postal code (Optional)

Click on Employment Information to update the following: \na. Employment Status 
- If Full-time Employee then user specifies: 
 Occupation 
 Employer Name 
 Annual Income 
 Employer Country  
 Employer City 
- If Business Owner then user specifies: 
 Business Type 
 Business annual income 
 Business name 
 Business country 
 Business city 
- If Freelance then user specifies: 
 Business type 
 Business annual income 
- If Unemployed then user specifies: 
 Select source of income 
 Total annual income 
- If Retired then user specifies  
 Total annual income \nb. Do you have any additional source of income? 
- If yes, user is requested to specify additional income source
Tick the checkbox to confirm information
Click on “Submit” to continue
NOTE: if user is ineligible for online KYC, then they are requested to visit the branch
Prepare to scan National ID
Click on “Next”
Scan the front of the ID by fitting it within the frame
Scan the back of the ID by fitting it within the frame
Check scanned ID Information
Click on “Confirm”

Upload supporting documents if requested including: 
a. Proof of Passport 
b. Proof of Income 
c. Proof of Address 
d. Proof of Residency
Click “Upload Document” to upload from files
Click “Take Photo” to open camera
Click “Next” to proceed
Verify information update through OTP
Information is updated successfully and reflected on core
NOTE: Some requests will be sent to branch support and/or compliance for review for rejection or approval
NOTE: In case of rejection, the user will receive the rejection message upon login and can make another update request
NOTE: in case of approval, the user’s information will be reflected on core and is informed that his information has been successfully updated
